name: zc_stage_lights

tests.name: the wardrobe's stage actor is in the world
all three stage lights were found
at least one stage light's attenuation radius actually reaches the figure

detail.note: a point light contributes nothing past its attenuation radius, however many candelas it has. The stage is scaled to about a ninth to bring the figure to the window, and component scale scales that radius with it.

tests.name: the figure responds to the stage's own lights

detail.note: fifty times the light. If the window does not brighten, the stage lights are not lighting the figure at all and their intensity was never the question.
